parametrized_description: A hospital needs to transport TotalPatients patients every day. A type II ambulance can move AmbulanceCapacity patients every shift and costs the hospital AmbulanceCost. A hospital van can move VanCapacity patients and costs the hospital VanCost every shift. The hospital can have at most MaxVanShiftProportion of shifts be hospital vans due to union limitations of the type II ambulance drivers. How many shifts using each type of vehicle should be scheduled to minimize the total cost to the hospital?

NumPatients.description: Number of patients to be transported daily

CapacityAmbulance.description: Capacity of a Type II ambulance in terms of patients per shift

CostAmbulance.description: Cost of a Type II ambulance per shift

CapacityVan.description: Capacity of a hospital van in terms of patients per shift

CostVan.description: Cost of a hospital van per shift

MaxVanShiftsPercent.description: Maximum percentage of shifts that can be hospital vans

NumAmbulanceShifts.description: Number of shifts using a type II ambulance

NumVanShifts.description: Number of shifts using a hospital van

constraints.description: Number of ambulance shifts is non-negative
Number of van shifts is non-negative
Total patients transported must be at least NumPatients

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(CapacityAmbulance * NumAmbulanceShifts + CapacityVan * NumVanShifts >= NumPatients, name="MinPatientsConstr")

constraints.description: The number of van shifts must not exceed MaxVanShiftsPercent of total shifts

objective.description: Minimize the total cost to the hospital
